name: web-synais-device-mockups-on-leather-armchair-and-couch
title: Synais landing page on laptop and phone mockups posed on a maroon leather armchair and couch
whatItIs: A grid of six realistic device mockups: an open laptop resting on a folding chair's leather seat, a phone lying face-up on a leather couch, and further laptop/phone angles on the same furniture, all showing the Synais hero page.
whatItMeans: Tactile and premium; leather furniture mockups lend a screen design a physical, editorial presence.
techniques: Pose devices on furniture that matches the brand palette.
Vary device angle and distance across a mockup set.
Use consistent lighting across all mockup shots.

vocabulary.definition: A realistic image showing a design on a physical device.
